atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 theme directive — defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, animations, etc.) for the project. Use `@theme inline` to scope tokens to the current file.

atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: CSS @import — Tailwind v4 uses `@import "tailwindcss"` to load the framework.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 config directive — points to a JavaScript config file for custom configuration.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 plugin directive — registers a Tailwind plugin.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 source directive — explicitly registers scan paths for class detection.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 variant directive — defines custom variants like `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 utility directive — defines a custom utility class.
